title: New DOL Rule is a Win for Dashers
summary: A new independent contractor rule issued by the US Dept. of Labor recognizes the importance of independent work.
body_markdown:
Today, the Department of Labor announced their final independent contractor rule. This rule is a win for the millions of Dashers and Americans who work independently.


> “We welcome the Department of Labor’s final rule, which respects the individual choices millions of Americans make to earn on their own terms. Dashers choose independent work for the flexibility to earn when, where and how they want. This rule recognizes that reality.”
> **Max Rettig, Global Head of Public Policy at DoorDash**


**What does this mean for Dashers?**


This rule does not change the way dashing works. Dashers were properly classified before this rule took effect, and remain properly classified as independent contractors under this rule. That means Dashers can continue to work on their own schedules and earn on their own terms.
